title: kith-store: upsert_discovered_contact (preserve user-set displayName)
description:
Add a new contact store method for the auto-discovery flow that is idempotent and preserves user-set display names.

What: New method on ContactStore alongside the existing upsert().

Algorithm:
1. Add to ContactStore:
   pub fn upsert_discovered_contact(
     &self,
     peer_user_id: &str,
     peer_login: &str,
     peer_mailbox_host: &str,
     discovered_display_name: Option<&str>,
     now_unix: i64,
   ) -> Result<(), KithError>

2. Implement with SQL:
   INSERT INTO contacts
     (peer_user_id, peer_login, peer_mailbox_host, display_name, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, blocked)
   VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?5, 0)
   ON CONFLICT(peer_user_id) DO UPDATE SET
     peer_login        = excluded.peer_login,
     peer_mailbox_host = excluded.peer_mailbox_host,
     display_name      = CASE WHEN display_name IS NULL THEN excluded.display_name ELSE display_name END,
     last_seen_at      = excluded.last_seen_at
   -- first_seen_at and blocked are NOT updated on conflict

3. Tests (independent oracle: SQLite CASE WHEN semantics, verified manually):
   - Test 1 'new contact': call with all fields; assert row inserted with all values.
   - Test 2 'existing contact, NULL display_name': call again with new discovered_display_name; assert display_name updated.
   - Test 3 'existing contact, non-NULL display_name': call again with different discovered_display_name; assert existing display_name preserved.
   - Test 4 'idempotent': call twice with same args; assert single row, no error.
   - Test 5 'first_seen_at preserved': insert then call again; assert first_seen_at unchanged.
   - Test 6 'blocked preserved': insert, set blocked=1, call upsert_discovered_contact; assert blocked still 1.

Defensive programming rules:
- Never update 'blocked' on conflict (user block choice is preserved)
- Never update 'first_seen_at' on conflict
- Only update display_name if it was NULL (CASE WHEN in SQL)
- peer_user_id, peer_login, peer_mailbox_host must be non-empty (validate before calling)
